caso.texto:
Appointment Desk received a form requesting WhatsApp information about meeting scheduling. The buyer asks about price and timing, prefers text and supplied no migration inputs. The offer configures two calendars, excluding historical imports. The rep prepared six voice notes and promised tomorrow.

A Bengaluru training provider requests written English and an invoice review by accounts. Calendar access and tax treatment are unconfirmed. An initial channel choice does not justify automated promotional reminders after a stop request.

projeto.instrucoes: Rewrite the conversation in six turns, clarify scope and dependencies and draw branches for questions, acceptance, silence and refusal.
projeto.gabarito: Start with the actual enquiry and use text. Price and timing must reflect confirmed terms. Explain excluded history and required access; withdraw the unsupported tomorrow promise. Refusal stops the flow and silence does not prove interest.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
